scope: Public restoration development failures and exact collection limits; original evidence retained.

failures.observed: Both strict compiles pass; snapshot database tests pass12/fail1. The new test attempted Pending-to-Running and received InvalidState before reaching its expected restoration binding Conflict.
failures.correction: Test now takes the valid Starting transition before asserting that unactivated Running publication is refused. The ownership assertion remains unchanged; no production transition or error policy was relaxed.

failures.observed: 36 SDK tests execute; one new sync test expected UncertainRequest after its first lost reply, but existing keyed transport retries up to three times before TransportError.
failures.correction: The synthetic transport now loses all three attempts; the test requires TransportError, then retries explicitly with the same key and validates the same target/bindings. No production retry behavior was changed.

subsequent_test_hygiene_change: The migration/reopen fixture now catches panic, closes all opened Store pools, then removes its directory before resuming the panic; the raw migration connection closes before asserting its result. Full validation is run on that later source map.

retained_failed_test_directory.automatic_approval: rejected the combined ownership-inspection and deletion command before process creation
retained_failed_test_directory.reported_reason: blocked by policy; no more specific reason was provided

authorization_review.authoritative_contract: docs/m3-delivery.md lines15-18 and protocol KeyResources::permits: exact sandbox grants do not include descendants; independent creation requires an all-resource grant.
authorization_review.draft_problem: The draft automatically extended source grants to new restoration targets. Passing draft tests did not prove preservation of the accepted M3 authorization contract.
authorization_review.correction: Restoration POST, including exact retries, requires all-resource Write authority. Target resources/operations/executions keep exact new-target grants. Removed inherited-authority traversal and its arbitrary lineage limit; source provenance remains immutable snapshot metadata.
